subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Radium is one of / the most valuable metal / in the world.
solution:
The erroneous part is option 4) i.e. 'the most valuable metal.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part 'the most valuable metal.'
 
• According to the rules of nouns, after** 'one of the' **the noun is used in plural form.
 
• Therefore in the given sentence, we need to use 'the most valuable metals' in place of 'the most valuable metal' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct sentence:__ *Radium is one of **the most valuable metals** in the world.*
